. Debating whether the tensions in the region are a result of or a cause for the arms race dynamics that have taken hold is not what today’s security environment requires. Instead, political and military leaderships of states in the region should undertake initiatives that prioritize averting the very real and growing risks of unintended use of nuclear weapons or escalation of a lower level conflict to the nuclear level. Eighty years after nuclear weapons were invented and last used in anger, humanity still struggles with whether it can muster the maturity, expertise and awareness necessary to protect themselves against the consequences of wide scale nuclear use.
